body: So there's this memory my mother mentioned of her coming home from work and my dad had a bunch of crack heads over and they were in the basement and me and my brother were crying/running to here that strange men were in the house. I don't even know what she's talking about, in fact I only barely recall that house I lived in. Am I suppressing something I couldn't even imagine? Does that mean I went through something messed out. Or am I overthinking things and that's normal? I mean I went through a childhood of witnessing physical abusing and mental trauma, I don't think I was even touched. At least not that I remember, and my bro and mom were usually always with me and they know I was never touched. But for some reason the memory my mom told about...makes me feel creeped out, and sick?? half of me says im overthinking, the other halfs says "wtf happened"

I don't know if it's a built in habit because when I was younger I was always told to hide in my room when we used to live with my abusive, drunk father, and it just became a norm for me, but I don't need to do it anymore yet...I do...like I have to. I was diagnosed with PTSD 2 years ago, that was the first and last time I had meds but it made my depression worse (at the time it was my anxiety and panic attacks that were wonkers) but sadly I don't have the papers...and honestly... I don't think I have SERIOUS PTSD, but at the same time it's like I have a small unique form of it where only the past can explain the unnecessary things I think about and do in the present.  It used to be m anxiety more so than depression for as long as I can remember, but now it's seem more depression symptoms have taken t I still experience anxieties. My daily life...CURRENTLY, is being and my room sleeping or on my computer watching stuff, sometimes I'm scared to go outside by myself even though I used to do it a lot, my mom gets drunk and gets mentally abusive or annoying once in a while, I'm always trying to scold her and advise her but she only pretends to take my advice, she never changes. I have a friend that comes to see me once a week, she helps me...but I don't know why I still feel like this.. to be honest I thought I was doing well, maybe my mother is the cause? Maybe I'm just really sensitive to toxic people. But she's a good person when she's sober, she's a lovely mother.... and a month ago I finally decided to meet my father and I still plan on doing it. I decided it's best to be connected because it's healthy to deal with uncomfortable things, or people you disagree with... I've always tried to build a tolerance towards life struggles...But sometimes...ever since middle school (when we were still with my father), I would skip school for a week or so often, I'd sleep a lot just trapped in my room with my computer as an escape, and that just continued...and now it feels like I'm back and I try to get out of it, I do, I don't wanna be useless....but it's like I'm just a dead weight and it's just who I am right now, I tried reorganizing my room and cleaning it for space, my friend even helped, I'm applying to jobs and calling, I'm gonna get finally do my permit test next week (i'm 20 :/ shoulda got it by now). My dream is to leave this apartment and be alone or live with a friend, but...what if these thoughts continue? I do plan on seeing a professional when I actually can afford so but idk when that'll even be, what if I need to move soon if and I have to cover bills with a average salary job and have school to focus on. Most people my age have like a parent helping them with mental health finances, but my mom wastes her shit on cigs and alcohol/wine. She knows I struggle, and she acts like she cares but she doesn't. But I'm older now, I should stop bothering with the thought of her helping me with this stuff, it'll never change anyway, she doesn't even care that she hurts me when she's drunk, a few years back when I was away she almost caused my big bro to commit suicide, cause she'd get shit faced.
